text: きめたぞ　ここに　テントを　はろうっと

patterns.name: 〜ようっと
patterns.explanation: The 'let's' form of a verb plus っと is what you say to yourself when you have just made up your mind. はろうっと = 'I think I'll pitch it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, boyish way to stress what you declare. きめたぞ = 'I've decided!'.
